scientific_integrity: Exact proof based on induced-path types and cyclic gap decomposition; finite Python checks are corroborative and do not establish the infinite statements. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Even crown posets on N>=4 labeled vertices only; does not address arbitrary posets or undirected cycle-graph partial automorphisms.
The exact rank polynomial is given by a finite multitype transfer coefficient rather than a simplified univariate generating function.
The growth laws specify leading logarithmic exponents, not multiplicative constants.
Related general or previously unindexed enumerations may still cover all or part of the result.
title: Rank polynomial and half-factorial growth of finite crown partial-automorphism monoids
